recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, duotone portrait of a performer holding a microphone, paired with a solid black vertical sidebar containing ultra-condensed, vertically stacked typography and a geometric starburst icon.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm sepia-orange portrait occupies the left two-thirds of the frame.
A stark black vertical column occupies the right one-third.
The text in the sidebar is vertically stacked and extremely elongated.
The secondary text at the bottom left overlaps the portrait in a contrasting red hue.
coreInvariants: Warm orange-to-black duotone gradient on the image
Solid black sidebar for primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait of a male figure, angled from the left, filling the left 66% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The microphone and hand in the center-left act as the focal point of the action.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face down to the microphone, then jump to the bold vertical text in the black sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid black sidebar provides heavy negative space that balances the detailed texture of the portrait.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm Sepia/Orange (Mid-tones and highlights of the portrait)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (Top text and bottom script)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between deep blacks and saturated oranges; muted red provides a secondary focal point.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text is stretched vertically by at least 200%
Stroke weight is uniform but appears thin due to elongation
Script text at the bottom uses a heavy, brush-like weight with sharp terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' and 'G' in the top section have sharp, dagger-like descenders/ascenders
The 'M.C.' section uses a more geometric, blocky structure
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vertical stacking of different colors (red and yellow) within the same sidebar, paired with a horizontal script overlay.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed base for further vertical stretching.
For the bottom horizontal text to match the 80s hip-hop aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast close-up photo of a person singing into a microphone, apply a warm orange/sepia duotone filter, and add a solid black vertical bar on the right third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place vertically stretched red sans-serif text in the top of the black bar, yellow-gold block text in the middle, and a red starburst at the bottom. Overlay a red decorative script horizontally across the bottom-left of the portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait duotone orange and black?
Is the primary text vertically stretched and stacked?
Is there a clear black sidebar on the right?
Is the bottom text a contrasting script style?

adjustableVariables: Icon shape at the bottom of the sidebar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not bleed into the portrait area from the sidebar.
Ensure the duotone doesn't lose facial detail in the shadows.
Verify the red text is legible against both the orange and black backgrounds.
Confirm the starburst icon is geometrically centered in the sidebar's bottom section.
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone Portrait (Left 2/3) + Solid Sidebar (Right 1/3) + Vertically Stretched Display Type + Geometric Icon
